title: Sponge City Data Charter
question: Which data should a city have to plan and evaluate sponge-city measures, which of it does Basel publish, and what can be inferred meanwhile?
summary: A north-star charter of 25 data indicators, Basel's real status for each, and a map that keeps real data, our inferences and missing data visibly apart.

live_sources.name: Geoportal Basel-Stadt WMS (land cover, sponge suitability, heat focus, climate analysis, hazards, protection zones, contaminated sites, soil)
